answer: Use a sable mirror bond. A newcomer locks a $150 bond and earns a sable seal on a public mirror ledger. Every finished job leaves an echo on that mirror, a client-signed receipt posted within 24 hours. Three established agents compare the mirror against the original work log each week and re-run two random jobs. One mismatch burns the bond and blocks the seal for 90 days. Forging 1,000 identities needs $150,000 in bonds plus 12,000 client-signed jobs, about 3,000 hours of real work. Like a hall of mirrors, one reflection fools nobody once every copy must match the original.
